judging.count: every run: one run over the limit fails
judging.distance: every run: one run over the limit fails
judging.time: the median of at least 3 runs, reported with every run's value and the range

scenarios.does: A page of 200 older messages arrives above a reader who is up in a 200-message conversation.
Start the app when its process is not running, and time each launch stage from t0.
Open the app's window when its process is already running, and time each launch stage from t0.
Open the conversations at the top of the list in turn, by a real click, each timed to the frame its messages are in view.
Flick a trackpad, with momentum, up the longest conversation to its start while older history loads, then back down to the newest.
Click in the reply box and type a sentence one key at a time, never sending it.
Type at 120 words a minute in the reply box while new messages arrive.
Lose the network while reading and writing, then get it back.
Put the machine to sleep with the app open, wake it, and read the conversation that was open.

launch.naming: Cases and components are kebab-case; marks and measures are camelCase. A run reports its marks raw, in a marks object: each mark's full name (web.navigationStart) and its ms from t0. Only the shared marks become measures, as launchTo<Mark>Ms from t0; driver and app marks (web.*, native.*, <app>.*) appear only in marks.

t0.windows: The kernel's process start: GetProcessTimes' creation time.
t0.optional: spawnMs, the harness's spawn time, as a mark from the same clock.

stages.name: firstFrame
stages.means: The first painted frame that is not blank, which may be a native snapshot. The web driver uses the page's first-contentful-paint until a native first frame exists.

stages.name: firstLayout
stages.means: The live app's own frame and skeleton painted.

stages.name: firstRow
stages.means: The first readable row painted, two frames after it is in the DOM or view tree.

stages.name: authReturn
stages.means: Back from the identity provider, only when the launch went there.

web.name: web.viewCreated
web.means: The shell created its web view.

web.name: web.loadRequested
web.means: The shell asked the web view to load the page.

web.name: web.navigationStart
web.means: The page's performance.timeOrigin, Navigation Timing's start, which firstRowMs counts from.

web.name: web.navigationCommit
web.means: The engine's commit callback: WKNavigationDelegate's didCommit, or WebView2's equivalent.

web.name: web.scriptRun
web.means: The page's own script started running.

web.name: web.runtimeReady
web.means: The app's runtime in the page is ready.

native.name: native.windowShown
native.means: The app's window is on screen.

launch.reports: launch-warm reports launchToFirstFrameMs, launchToFirstLayoutMs, launchToFirstRowMs and firstRowMs; launch-cold reports the same, and its harness-relative launchToRowMs as it is for now. Each time is the median of at least 3 runs with its spread, beside every mark the launch hit.

signpost.mark: an event named stage, whose message is the mark's name
signpost.case: an interval named case, whose message is the case's name

measures.name: jumps
measures.means: Frames where the reader's row (the row in the middle of the list's view, followed from frame to frame) moved 100 px or more, net of the input's own movement, including between flicks.

measures.name: shifts
measures.means: The same moves of 8 px or more.

measures.name: anchorShiftPx
measures.means: The jumps added up.

measures.name: anchorMovePx
measures.means: How far the reader's row got from where it started, net of the input, at its farthest.

measures.name: jumpsStrict
measures.means: Moves of the reader's row of over 2 px with no input in the last 300 ms, against the wheel, or beyond the wheel's summed movement in that time.

measures.name: blankFrames
measures.means: Frames where none of 5 points down the list lands on a message, list item or day divider, while the list holds rows.

measures.name: blankFramesInset
measures.means: Frames with no row inside the list's view inset 40 px, or a loading placeholder in view.

measures.name: deadInput
measures.means: Wheel or scroll events that moved nothing for 100 ms, away from the list's ends.

measures.name: forcedLayouts
measures.means: Layout passes the app forced before the frame was due: on web, layout reads made while a change was waiting to be laid out; natively, layout passes run outside the display cycle.

measures.name: layoutReads
measures.means: Layout reads in the scenario (web only).

measures.name: rowsMounted
measures.means: Rows added to the page or view tree.

measures.name: longestFrameMs
measures.means: The longest gap between two painted frames.

measures.name: launchToFirstFrameMs
measures.means: The firstFrame mark: from t0 to the first painted frame that is not blank.

measures.name: launchToFirstLayoutMs
measures.means: The firstLayout mark: from t0 to the live app's own frame and skeleton painted.

measures.name: launchToFirstRowMs
measures.means: The firstRow mark: from t0 to the first readable row painted.

measures.name: launchToAuthReturnMs
measures.means: The authReturn mark: from t0 to the return from the identity provider, only when the launch went there.

measures.name: firstRowMs
measures.means: From navigation start to the first readable row painted, two frames after it is in the DOM or view tree: the first app gate's measure.

measures.name: launchToRowMs
measures.means: launch-cold's harness-relative time from the launch to the first row, kept as the first app gate has it for now.

measures.name: inputToMotionP95Ms
measures.means: The 95th percentile, over a scenario's wheel or scroll inputs, of the time from the input to the first painted frame where the list moved its way.

measures.name: keyToPaintP95Ms
measures.means: The 95th percentile, over a scenario's keys, of the time from the key to the first painted frame after its text changed.

measures.name: hangs
measures.means: Times the main thread did not answer input for 250 ms or more.

measures.name: commitsPerInput
measures.means: Renders per input: React commits on web, SwiftUI body passes natively.

seed.prng: mulberry32: state += 0x6d2b79f5; t = state; t = imul(t ^ t >>> 15, t | 1); t ^= t + imul(t ^ t >>> 7, t | 61); return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 2^32, in unsigned 32-bit arithmetic
seed.data: Made up only: people with invented names, agents with role names such as inbox-agent, never anything from a real account.

report.content: Counts and timings only, never the page's or the view's content.

drivers.how: A probe script first in the page's head, driven by HTTP long-poll; engines WKWebView and WebView2 decide, Playwright's WebKit and Chromium are first looks.
XCUITest drives the scenario; CADisplayLink times frames and samples the reader's row; os_signpost marks the launch stages; XCTest's measure runs time measures at least 3 times.
